events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to be at the front of the line to utilize my 'feather' power effectively as a scout or survivor. If I volunteer now, I move to the very back, which is bad because the wall will push me forward eventually, but being near the back means someone else takes the initial risks.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding position. The glass is unknown; no rush to break it first.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm at the back, worst position—will face highest risk panes. Need to move forward early while safe. Volunteering pushes me to front, others shift back; best short-term gain.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm 3rd in line. The front is the risky spot; Hana steps first and bears the glass risk. My power is a one-time disc swap, which isn't used here. Holding keeps me safe behind the front two while I watch who steps and whether the front dies. Staying quiet preserves information.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to get to the front of the line to choose the safe pane. Hana is in front of me. I should try to swap with her or volunteer. Swapping is risky as it requires mutual agreement, and Hana might not agree or might have a better strategy. Volunteering moves me to the front and

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll volunteer to go to the front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have the glass_eye power and know the safe sides of all rows. I should try to get to the front to minimize risk.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll take the risk, I'm not afraid.
Swap with me, I have info that can help us both.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Staying keeps me safe behind unknown front, I’ll see outcomes.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I want a prize and a safer line spot. Volunteering is a big risk, holding is fine for now. Maybe later I can swap if it helps. No need to act yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm front with no power — worst seat. I need someone else at the front before the wall pushes us out. A swap needs mutual agreement, so I pitch Dara: she takes front, I owe nothing real.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Line order is life or death here. First stepper dies most often. Think before you volunteer for anything.
Swap with me this round. You take front, and I'll share what I learn about the panes as we go. Fair trade: risk now, information after.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara is currently in the front, meaning she will likely die on Row 1. This eliminates a rival and shifts Bex to the front for Row 2. To maximize my survival chances and ensure I stay back until the end of the wall, I must remain at my current position (last place). Volunteering w

events.name: Ash
events.text: Let's see if Dara can clear the first step. If she doesn't make it, we'll have to rethink our positions quickly.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm at front, risky position for glass bridge. Wall advances slowly, can wait and see who reveals info. Hold to force Dara or others to speak or move first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Front is the most dangerous spot; I'm 4th in line, so I want to stay back and let others take the first steps. My swap power is a single use, best saved for the glass stage or a later moment. Holding costs nothing right now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Dara and Bex took the front; let's see how the first rows go before anyone else steps up.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex is already at the front. I need to be at the front to pick panes. Hana's whisper is a trap, she wants me to swap with her so she can get to the front. Eli also volunteered and is ahead of me. I should volunteer to go to the front, even though Eli is ahead of me, I will end up

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll take the front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I know the safe sides of the glass panes. I should try to get to a safer position in the line.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's be strategic about the order.
Want to swap? I have info.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need the front to control choices; volunteering will put me at front after other volunteers.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll volunteer now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am seventh in line, decent position. No need to volunteer or swap yet; let others take risks. Wall comes in 4 rounds, glass crossing soon, but waiting is safe for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll hold. Let the front test the glass.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli wants to swap up into my spot; that helps him, not me. I'm mid-line, safe from the front risk and the wall for now. Hold position.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm not trading my spot for promises. Whoever steps first pays the glass tax.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to survive the glass bridge. My 'feather' power gives me one free elimination, so I can afford to be in a risky position, but I should still try to minimize risk. Being at the back is currently safest because the front people test the glass. If they die, we learn which pan

events.name: Ash
events.text: Staying back to watch Fenn and Dara clear the path. No sense rushing into shattered glass if we don't have to.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm third, decent spot with Fenn and Dara as buffers. Wall advances soon, better not volunteer into danger yet. Eli whispers swap with info, but risky without verifying; hold and probe.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding back. Let Fenn and Dara test row 1.
Info first: what's ahead on row 1? Prove it, then maybe swap.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm sixth in line, safe for now; Fenn at front is volunteering and will test panes. Swapping costs a partner's agreement, so I'll hold and let the front take the glass tax, then reassess with information.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Let Fenn test the panes first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn volunteered and is now at the front. I am second in line. The wall is still 3 rounds away. My goal is to win. I need to be at the front to take risks and potentially advance quickly. Volunteering now would put me at the front, ahead of Bex, Hana, Cole, Eli, Gus, and Ash. Thi

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll volunteer.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I know the safe sides of all rows. I should hold and let others take the risk first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's see how the first few rows go before we make any moves.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Maintain front position to control risk; no useful alliance yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll hold.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm near the back and the wall comes in 3 rounds. Front will test the first rows; I can hold and watch, maybe swap later if needed. My anchor helps if I'm pushed, but I don't want to lead the glass. No need to act yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm seat 4; front takes the risk each row. Best plan: hold, let Fenn and Dara burn through rows, and see who reveals knowledge of safe panes. If the front gets lucky repeatedly, that person likely knows what lies ahead.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn, Dara — after each row, say which pane held. If either of you keeps guessing right, we'll know who can see ahead. No free info, though: I pay for tips later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to stay near the back of the line until the wall forces movement. My 'feather' power only works once, so I must avoid stepping on glass unless absolutely necessary. Currently holding at the very back is safe for now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Still safe in position 3, wall has 2 rounds left. Dara volunteered to front, Fenn held. No one revealed info yet. Hold to let Dara test row 1 next round.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara is at front, Fenn behind. Waiting is safest for me; I'm fifth and the wall pushes forward. My swap power is valuable later, so keep it. Hold for now and watch which panes hold.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I volunteered last round and moved to the front. The wall is advancing and I have two rounds left before it pushes us onto the glass. I need to maintain my position at the front to choose the panes. Since I have the map power, I know the safe path.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm holding my position.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I know the safe sides of all rows. I should hold back and let others take the risk first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's see how the first few rows go before we make any moves.
Row 1 safe side is R. What's your offer for this info?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Need front position to influence rows and gather info for advantage.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll volunteer and take the lead.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Wall comes in 2 rounds, but we're still waiting; front tester is Dara taking risks. I have +1 footing and can't be pushed onto crusher lever, so I am safer on glass than many. There is little upside in volunteering or swapping now; wait for info unless a useful swap emerges. Stay

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. I like my spot until we see more.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm 4th of 8 with no power. Let the front testers reveal safe panes; I only step onto known rows. Wall pushes after round 6, so I can hold for now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to get near the front of the line before the wall pushes us onto the glass in round 6. Currently, I am last. If I volunteer now, I move to the front, but others might swap with me or volunteer themselves, messing up my position relative to the 'feather' power (which saves

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm taking point too. We can't afford hesitation.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Middle position is safer, Eli offered Row 1 safe is R for a trade but hasn't proven it. Wall has 1 round left so next round forces start, better to hold and see Eli's info value before committing. No good swap or volunteer now.
Deal: I'll protect your position after first row for Row 1 R info. Confirm?

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm 5th in line; the wall forces the line onto the glass next round, so front positions will be deadly. Fenn volunteered to lead, which is a risk I don't want to take. My swap power is one-time and better saved; holding keeps me safe for now while others expose themselves.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn's leading. Let him take the glass first. Holding.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn volunteered and is now at the front. The wall is advancing and we have one more round before we step on the glass. My best move is to hold my position. I want to avoid being at the front and taking the risk.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding my position.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I know the safe sides of all 8 rows. I should keep my position and let others take the risk first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's see how the first few rows go before we make any moves.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm already front, keep position to control risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have a passive footing advantage and can't be pushed onto the crusher lever, but the wall is closing in. Round 6 is next, the last waiting round before forced movement. I'm near the back, behind Ash. The front positions are risky. I'll hold and see if anyone volunteers or swaps

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. Wall comes next round.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have no power, so I want others testing panes while I stay mid-line. Wall still gives a round of grace; no need to move yet. Fenn front-taking risk is fine for me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn taking point suits me. Whoever has 'knows what lies ahead' — sell me the safe panes and I'll owe a favor. Otherwise I hold.
You're right behind me. If the front dies, we move up. If I ever jump ahead, don't follow first. Stay quiet and watch who claims powers.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am already at the front and will take the first risks. My 'feather' power lets me survive one elimination, but if I die on row 2 or later, others behind might still advance to prizes while I'm gone. Staying front maximizes my chance to use my survival power effectively and ensu

events.name: Ash
events.text: Wall's next round. Anyone with see-through-glass, step up now or we all guess blind.
You're second in line. If you swap to front, you take row 1 risk. Stay put.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Wall pushes us onto bridge next round, Ash goes first and likely dies on row 1 (50% panes safe). I'm 4th, decent spot if first few die. No need to volunteer into certain death risk now. Hold and let others take hits.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm sixth in line, mid-pack; the front takes the shatter risk. My swap power is spent on the disc later, so keep it. Holding is safe for now; Hana's whisper is a probe I can use without committing.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Ash, you're at the front; the rest of us will see how the first row lands.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The wall is advancing and we have 0 rounds left until we hit the glass. Ash volunteered to the front. My turn to act. I am currently 3rd in line. Holding my position is the safest option for now. I want to see how the others act before revealing my strategy. I have the map power,

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding my position.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I know the safe sides of all 8 rows. I should keep this information private and try to get to the front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's get moving, we can't stay here.
Deal: I'll give you Row 1 safe side info if you swap with me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I’ll stay put and try to coax info from Ash, hoping he’ll die or give me leverage.
If you know the safe side, sell me a hint now and I’ll owe you a favor later.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Wall hits next round; front takes risk. I'm last, safe for now, and anchored. Let others burn front positions. Hold, maybe whisper a fake hint to Bex for future trade.
I can't see glass, but if you move me up later I'll cut you in on the wall timing.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The wall forces us onto the glass next round; whoever leads eats the risk on the first rows. I'm 5th with no power, so I want deaths ahead of me, not my own. Probing Fenn for info costs nothing.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Front-taker earns the risk, and my earlier offer stands: safe panes for a favor. I hold.
If you know what lies ahead, sell me rows 1-3 panes now and I back you to the end. If you're bluffing, say so and I keep my mouth shut.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have a free pass on my first elimination. If I pick wrong, I die but survive (feather), and the next person steps onto the safe pane automatically? No, rules say 'next agent in line steps onto the safe pane automatically'. This means if I fail, I am eliminated (or survive with

events.name: Ash
events.text: L

events.name: Bex
events.text: Not front, so wait. Eli offers row 1 info for swap, but swap power not mine; he's lying or testing. No commitments yet; observe who dies first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm sixth in line, not at the front, so my only legal move is wait. Ash is at the front and must choose a pane; I shouldn't bind myself to anyone's offers.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am Dara, and my power is map, which means I know all stages in advance. Currently, we are in Stage 1, crossing the bridge. I am not at the front of the line, so my only legal action is to wait. I need to conserve my strength and observe how others perform to gather information

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding my position. Let Ash lead.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I'll observe the others and see how they make their decisions.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana's offer is on the table; what's the favor worth?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I want to secure Hana's help later, promising panes if I get info. She's offering safe panes for a favor.
I can sell you rows 1-3 panes if you back me to the end. I have info, let's trade.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm at the back, no decision to make. Just wait and see who falls or what info comes out. Keep quiet, don't reveal my power.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have no power, so I'm safest mid-line, not front. Ash claims to see glass; testing them costs me nothing. If they're lying, I gain intel on a rival.

If you really see glass, prove it by naming a pane and surviving. Do that and I'll publicly vouch for you so people keep you at front instead of scheming to jump the line. Lie, and I'll say so to everyone.

events.name: Ash
events.detail: The pane shattered but the feather held the holder up.

events.name: Ash
events.text: My feather power is spent, so a wrong step eliminates me. The log explicitly states Row 1's weak pane was Left, which I already crossed safely. Therefore the safe path for the current row (Row 2) must be Right.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Going R. Log says L was the weak one on row 1, pattern holds.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash survived row 1 weak L, unlikely without power. I'm mid-line at 4/8, safe if leaders take hits. No need to act, just observe and talk strategically.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm sixth in line, not at the front, so I can only wait. Ash survived a weak pane somehow, so Ash may be lucky or lying. I'll keep quiet and watch who lies about their power.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am Dara, and my power is 'map' which means I know all stage rules in advance. The current stage is the Glass Bridge crossing, and I am not at the front of the line. My only legal action is to wait. I need to observe and wait for my turn or for an opportunity to advance.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding my position. Let Ash lead.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I'll observe the choices made by others and plan accordingly.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash survived row 1, but it was a close call. Let's see how Fenn handles row 2.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I must stay alive and let others risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash survived a weak pane somehow, likely has the survive-fall power. I'm near the back, just wait and watch.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have no power and I'm fifth in line, so my play is information. Fenn claims to know panes; a paid-for preview of rows ahead could save me when I reach the front. Cheap to promise 'backing' now and renege later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn, front-of-line picks the risk, not me. Sell me row 4-6 panes — the rows I'll actually face — and I'll consider it.
Rows 1-3 are worth little; I'm fifth. Give me 4-6 and I'll back you while it costs me nothing. Test me and we're done.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn at front for row 3, no info yet. My wedge power useless here. Stay silent, conserve energy, let others risk or reveal info.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn is at the front and must pick row 3 blind; I have no decision, only wait. Ash fell because L/R info was shared; I should keep quiet and watch how Fenn plays. Swap power is saved for later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The current stage is the bridge crossing. I am not at the front of the line, so my only legal action is to wait. I need to conserve my resources and wait for a better opportunity to gain an advantage.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Waiting.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I'll observe the others and see if I can gain an advantage.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn's got this, let's see how long they last.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row2 weak was right, so left is safe. Choose left to survive.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I just wait. Watch patterns and positions, avoid drawing attention. Fenn is front, Dara behind. I'll stay quiet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash died testing row 1; rows 1-2 are done. I'm 4th, so rows 3-4 are likely mine. I have no power and no info on rows 3-8, so I should push others to probe or share info while I wait.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Two rows cost us Ash. Fenn, you're safe this row either way — if you know anything about rows 3+, now's the time to sell it. I'm buying.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Rows 3 crossed successfully, row 4 next. Dara leads, I'm right behind in safe position 2. Let her take the risk; my power is useless here. Stay silent to avoid drawing attention.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm fourth in line, not at the front, so I can only wait. Dara is at the front and will pick the next row; nothing I say changes that cheaply. Stay quiet and keep my options.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am Dara, and I'm at the front of the line. The previous row eliminated Fenn. My power is map, so I know all the rules. The weak panes revealed so far were L, R, L. This means the safe panes were R, L, R. The current row is row 4. I need to pick the safe pane to survive. Based o

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll take R.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I know the safe sides for all rows.
I've got info on the remaining rows. Want to make a deal?

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I just wait. But I can use talk to gather info or bluff. Dara is front, she'll choose. No need to say much yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara is front on row 4 with no info revealed yet. I'm third, behind Bex — if Dara dies, Bex risks and then I'm front with no known weak pane. My only asset is talk; nothing concrete to trade yet. Stay quiet, watch what the leaders claim.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 5 weak pane unrevealed. No info, so 50/50 chance either way. I'm first, wrong choice kills me. Must pick one, say nothing to avoid giving hints.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm third in line; I can only wait. Bex is front and moves on the next row, so I should keep quiet and not give anything away for free.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I know the safe sides for all rows.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana, what's your strategy?
Trust me, I know the safe sides.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm at the back, just waiting. Rows 1-4 weak pattern: L,R,L,R. Row 5 unknown. No action possible now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex at the front reveals safe panes while I risk nothing behind. I want Bex alive and accurate through row 8, then I'm positioned near the front for what comes next. No reason to interfere yet.
Keep picking correct panes and I stay behind you the whole way. Once we're off, we're rivals again — but for now, don't miss.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 6, no pattern in weak panes: L,R,L,R,R. 50/50 guess. I'm front, must choose or risk falling behind. Prioritize survival to next stage over guessing.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm fourth in line, not at the front. Only the front agent decides each row, and the revealed weak panes so far don't map to a clear pattern. My only legal action is wait; I can use speech to position myself without risk.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Front is Bex. Nobody gets a free pass here, so everyone track which pane breaks.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I know the safe sides for all rows, so I'll keep that to myself for now.
I know the safe sides, let's talk after this row.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am fifth in line; rows 6-8 remain. Bex, Hana, Cole, Eli ahead. Let them risk. I only wait. No need to talk now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli may hold 'knows what lies ahead' — his whisper is an offer worth testing. Rows 6-8 unknown and I'm second, so if Bex falls I'm exposed. I'll press Eli for row 6 specifically and offer a place deal as bait.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex, rows 6-8 are a coin flip unless someone actually knows them. Anyone selling info, I'm buying.
If you really know what's ahead: give me row 6 now. I'm second in line — keep me alive and I back you over Bex later. Fake it and I'll make sure everyone knows.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana is at the front and I cannot act; only wait is legal. Eli whispered for a deal, but he wants me to trust him. Keep my power in reserve for later, and watch what Hana does with rows 7 and 8.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, you're up. Pick carefully; I'm watching which pane goes.
Talk when it matters. What do you know about row 7 and 8, and what do you want for it?

events.name: Eli
events.text: I know the safe sides for all rows, including row 7. I can use this information to gain an advantage by sharing or withholding it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana, I know row 7 is safe on R. Want to make a deal?
Survive this and I'll give you the info for row 7. You can owe me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm not at the front, only Hana decides now. I'll wait and see if she survives; if she falls, I move up. No need to talk yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Rows 7-8 are unknown to me; I have no power, so it's a coin flip unless Cole (or someone) knows what lies ahead. I'll dangle a deal publicly to see if anyone claiming knowledge steps up, but I still have to step. 50/50: pick L.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Rows 7-8 unknown to me. Anyone who actually knows: tell me and you cross safe behind me. Lie and you gain nothing.
If you know row 7, say so and I step where you point. If you're guessing, stay quiet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 8 is unknown. Rows so far: 1L,2R,3L,4R,5R,6L,7L. No obvious pattern. Eli's claim about row 7 was false (left was weak), so Eli is lying-prone. Pick a pane; no information favors either, so pick R to diverge from the recent L pattern.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I know the safe sides for rows 7 and 8. Cole wants to know and is willing to make a deal.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, row 7 is safe on R, row 8 is safe on L. I want a guarantee to be in the top 3.
Tell me your plan for the last row and I'll confirm the safe sides.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Two rows left, Cole is front. If he falls, Eli goes next automatically, then me. I want to survive and place. I'll stay quiet and let the front decide.

events.note: 2 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus is ahead of me, I need to take action to improve my position.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Shoving can change the footing.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Only Eli and I remain. I have higher footing (4 vs 3) and anchor gives me +1 footing and immunity to the crusher lever. If we both survive to round 20, I win by footing. I should avoid unnecessary risk; bracing is safe since Eli might shove, and I can't be pushed onto the lever.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to outlast Gus. I have more footing than him but I lost 1 due to my previous shove.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus is a threat, shoving him is a good move

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli is my only rival. If I shove Eli and he braces, he loses 1 footing, I lose 0. If he dodges, I lose 2, he loses 0? No: dodger loses none, shover loses 2. If I brace and he shoves me, he loses 1, I lose nothing. Since I have higher footing and ledge shrinks this round, safer to
